info.title: API-DocTest-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v5-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Withdrawal Management API allows users to effectively remove withdrawal requests from their investment portfolios. This endpoint is essential for clients who need to adjust or cancel their withdrawal activities, ensuring that their portfolios align with their current investment strategy. Typical consumers include financial advisors and investment managers who require precise control over withdrawal transactions. The API streamlines portfolio management and enhances the user experience by providing a straightforward method to manage withdrawal requests.

delete.description: This operation allows users to withdraw funds from their specified portfolio. Ensure that sufficient balance is available to complete the transaction.

requestBody.description: Request payload for withdrawing from the portfolio. This operation requires the necessary parameters to specify the amount to withdraw and any relevant identification. Ensure all fields are filled out correctly to process the withdrawal effectively.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a withdrawal operation in the portfolio.
